meta.description: Domain-specific intents for the portfolio chatbot. Each intent has a tag, a set of example user patterns used to train the TF-IDF/keyword matcher, and one or more candidate responses.

responses: Hi there! 👋 I'm Nisa's portfolio assistant. Ask me about her projects, skills, experience, or how to get in touch.
Hello! Feel free to ask me anything about Khairunnisa's work as a Mobile Application Developer.
Thanks for stopping by! Feel free to reach out at khairunnisaaptr@gmail.com if you'd like to connect.
Goodbye! Don't forget to check out the projects section before you go. 👋
You're welcome! Let me know if there's anything else you'd like to know about Nisa's work.
Happy to help! Ask away if you have more questions.

patterns: give me an overview of your background
what kind of developer are you
responses: Khairunnisa is a Mobile Application Developer based in Indonesia, focused on building intuitive, production-ready mobile applications with Flutter and Android. She cares about creating apps that are fast, secure, and genuinely useful for the people who rely on them every day.

She's a Mobile Application Developer with hands-on experience building production-ready Flutter applications and the RESTful APIs behind them — including AI-powered features like biometric authentication, facial recognition, and location services.

patterns: what mobile frameworks do you use
tell me about your mobile development skills
what programming languages do you use
are you good at android development
what tools do you use for app development
responses: On the mobile side, Nisa works with Flutter, Kotlin, and Jetpack Compose, using Riverpod for state management, plus Google ML Kit and Google Maps for AI and location features.
Her core mobile stack is Flutter and Kotlin (Jetpack Compose), backed by REST API integration with Laravel, JWT authentication, and MySQL for the backend side.

patterns: what data science skills do you have
tell me about your AI experience
what machine learning tools do you use
have you worked on deep learning
responses: Yes — Nisa has experience with Python and PyTorch for deep learning, including NusaBERT for NLP tasks, and Google ML Kit for on-device computer vision features like facial verification.
Her AI/ML background includes deep learning with PyTorch (U-Net for medical image segmentation), NusaBERT for NLP, and applied ML with scikit-learn for recommendation systems.

patterns: what tools do you use for development workflow
how do you collaborate with a team
what tools do you use for testing APIs
responses: For workflow and collaboration, Nisa uses Git and GitHub for version control, Postman for API testing, and Figma for reviewing designs and handoff.

patterns: what projects have you worked on
responses: Nisa has worked on several projects: SoloHRIS (a Flutter enterprise attendance app), Bersih.Kan (an AI-powered waste management app, top 50 Bangkit Capstone), a White Blood Cell Segmentation deep learning model (her bachelor's thesis, graded A), and a Plant Recommendation System (ministry-funded research). Ask me about any one of them for more detail!

patterns: tell me about the hris project
how does the biometric attendance app work
what did you build at bank solo
tell me about the facial verification project
what is the GPS attendance validation project
responses: SoloHRIS is a Flutter-based mobile attendance application Nisa built for PT BPR Bank Solo (Perseroda), replacing their legacy web-based system. It features biometric authentication, Google ML Kit facial verification, GPS-based attendance validation, and a digital leave management workflow. It's built with Flutter, Laravel, REST API, Google ML Kit, and MySQL, and is currently used internally by 25+ employees.

patterns: tell me about the waste management app
what is the bangkit capstone project
tell me about your android project
responses: Bersih.Kan is an AI-powered waste management platform built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It helps users classify waste using machine learning and discover nearby recycling services. It was a Top 50 project in the Bangkit Capstone program.

patterns: tell me about the white blood cell project
tell me about your bachelor thesis
what is the wbc segmentation project
tell me about your deep learning project
what is u-net used for in your project
responses: Nisa's bachelor's thesis (graded A) focused on White Blood Cell Segmentation for AML detection, using a U-Net architecture with attention mechanisms to improve medical image segmentation. It was built with Python and PyTorch.

patterns: tell me about the plant recommendation system
tell me about your machine learning research
what is the ministry funded project
tell me about the svm project
responses: The Plant Recommendation System is a ministry-funded research project that predicts suitable plants based on environmental and soil characteristics, using Python, scikit-learn, SVM, and an Artificial Bee Colony optimization algorithm.

patterns: what do you do at bank solo
have you been a teaching assistant
responses: Nisa currently works as IT Staff at PT BPR Bank Solo (Perseroda) since November 2025, where she built SoloHRIS. Before that, she was a Software Developer Intern at DTIK UNS (Oct 2023 – Dec 2024), creating technical documentation for academic websites, and a Teaching Assistant for Android Development at Universitas Sebelas Maret (Feb–Jun 2024), mentoring 50+ students.

patterns: where did you go to university
responses: Nisa holds a Bachelor's Degree in Informatics from Universitas Sebelas Maret (2021–2025) with a GPA of 3.89. Her coursework included Android Development, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, OOP, Databases, and Data Structures & Algorithms.

patterns: can i get your phone number
how do i get in touch
responses: You can reach Nisa at khairunnisaaptr@gmail.com or +6285172454734. She's also on GitHub (github.com/nisarizqi) and LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/putririzqik) — feel free to connect!

responses: Sure — you can download her resume directly from the site (see the 'Resume' button in the hero section), or ask the recruiter link at the top of the page.
